scope: New receiver-external witness primitive implementation: durable authenticated-anchor retention, serialized one-time evidence consumption and restart reconciliation conditional on an independently retained trusted checkpoint. The tests model that separate checkpoint holder. No production witness service or external storage root is deployed or accepted.
implemented: Authenticate accepted supervisor anchor and verify full transcript against trusted prospective bindings/policy before retention
Retain exact authenticated anchor/context/binding digest under its unique launch identity
Exclusive OS file lock and per-instance mutex; reject second writer and fork-inherited use
Full-write/fsync-before-return journal and MAC-authenticated checkpoint with separate witness key
Mutations require exact previously returned external checkpoint; stale, wrong-key, wrong-witness and rollback mismatch fail closed
Consume retained anchor once with exact launch/context/anchor-byte digest; never grant admission
Reopen requires external checkpoint matching complete validated journal; never infer expected state from journal
Restart durably abandons every still-retained anchor; consumed and abandoned launches remain tombstoned
Partial records, uncertain fsync, lost acknowledgement, deletion and corruption do not create reset/retry authority
Directory-fd path traversal, O_NOFOLLOW, exclusive create, regular-file and hardlink checks
external_checkpoint_contract: Every returned checkpoint must be retained outside this journal by an independently authenticated, rollback-resistant authority before relying on it. It must not be reconstructed from the journal or rolled back with it. This component checks equality and authentication but DOES NOT implement that external authority. If journal and external checkpoint both roll back, this primitive alone cannot detect it. New journal identity enrollment also needs external uniqueness authority; callers cannot mint replacements as recovery.
reconciliation: Availability is intentionally conservative. A newer journal with an older external checkpoint blocks reopening. A matched restart abandons all unconsumed anchors, including after an uncertain consume whose bytes were lost. No import, reset, refill, reissue, compaction, or continuation of a pre-restart retained anchor exists. New independently authorized identities may be retained after successful reconciliation, but this API creates no such authority.
trust_assumptions: Trusted witness process/callers, provisioned distinct 32-byte supervisor and witness keys, genuine kernel/flock/fsync/proc platform
Private stable storage namespace; no malicious privileged writer while active
Independently established expected context/bindings/policy; no receiving-derived canonical membership
External checkpoint authentication/freshness/retention and unique witness enrollment remain prerequisites, not implementation outputs
limitations: No end-to-end externally rollback-resistant storage-root acceptance
No actual external witness network/key-provisioning service or key custody proof
No hostile same-size in-place journal rewrite or namespace replacement defense during an active trusted session
Reopen reconstruction rechecks anchor MACs/grammar and checkpoint chain, not unavailable retained full transcripts; transcript verification occurred before each retention
Tests model crash/ACK/write loss and real reopen, not exhaustive power-loss, kernel or storage fault behavior
Continuous lifetime enforcement, descriptor-passing/later-exec resistance, VM entry-path/hidden-input provenance, derivative toolchain and immutable deployment remain open
Complete canonical manifest, supervisor/receiver/admission, prepared worker, sealed launch and R1 remain open
qualification: 36 deterministic synthetic/non-corpus unittest methods, local attempt 1 PASS; positive retention/consumption/reopen plus adversarial replay, rollback, stale/wrong checkpoints, uncertain writes, corrupted/partial/missing journals, aliases, concurrent consume and second writer. No socket, JVM or experimental worker is launched.
review_requested: Independent Reviewer B source/durable evidence consumption/checkpoint-conditioned restart review only. No self-adoption. All adopted implementation/V2 bytes remain untouched.
